WD Blue SN5000 2TB NVMe SSD Specifications

​The WD Blue SN5000 is a high-performance NVMe SSD designed for creators and professionals. It represents the next step in the WD Blue lineup, moving to PCIe Gen 4.0 technology to deliver significantly faster speeds than previous generations while maintaining the reliability and power efficiency the Blue series is known for.

​Performance Specifications

  • ​Capacity: 2TB
  • ​Interface: PCIe Gen 4.0 x4
  • ​Form Factor: M.2 2280
  • ​Sequential Read Speed: Up to 5,150 MB/s
  • ​Sequential Write Speed: Up to 4,850 MB/s
  • ​Random Read (IOPS): Up to 650K
  • ​Random Write (IOPS): Up to 770K

​Durability & Reliability

  • ​Endurance (TBW): 900 TBW (Terabytes Written)
  • ​MTTF: 1.75 Million Hours
  • ​Technology: nCache™ 4.0 for optimized thermal management and high-speed bursting.

​Features

  • ​NVMe 4.0: Fully utilizes the increased bandwidth of modern motherboards while remaining backward compatible with PCIe Gen 3.0 slots (at reduced speeds).
  • ​Western Digital SSD Dashboard: Free downloadable software to monitor drive health, temperature, and performance.
  • ​Acronis True Image: Included software for cloning drives and backing up data.
  • ​Low Power Consumption: Designed to extend battery life for laptop users without sacrificing high-speed data access.

​Key Highlights

  • ​Boosted Workflow: Ideal for handling large 4K video files, heavy multitasking, and reducing loading times in creative applications.
  • ​PCIe Gen 4 Upgrade: Offers a significant performance jump over the older SN580 and SN570 models.
  • ​Reliable Endurance: With a 900 TBW rating, it is built to handle heavy daily write cycles over many years.
  • ​One-Sided Design: The slim M.2 2280 profile makes it compatible with ultra-thin laptops and compact desktop builds.
